description: instagram: Trending Reels. GET /v1/instagram/reels/trending. Get the reels Instagram's signed-out Reels feed (instagram.com/reels/) is showing right now, usually 8: shortcode, URL, caption, publication date (taken_at as ISO 8601, taken_at_timestamp in seconds), video and image URLs, like and comment counts, audio info and the creator. This is Instagram's own signed-out feed, not a ranked global chart, and repeated calls can overlap. Play counts are not in this feed: play_count Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.
name: instagram_reels_trending
